discard: Your changes to the init script are not saved. Leave them?

errors.script_too_large: The script is larger than {max} bytes.
errors.param_name: Param name "{name}" must be uppercase letters, digits and _ and start with a letter.
errors.param_reserved: Param name "{name}" is reserved: OCTOPUS_* is set by the runner.
errors.timeout: The ready timeout must be between 1 and {max} seconds.
errors.workdir: The workdir must be a path inside the repo: relative and without ..
errors.setup_too_large: The setup script is larger than {max} bytes.
errors.tools: Write tools as name=version, e.g. go=1.25.1: {tools}
errors.cache_path: Cache paths must be relative to the workdir, without .., and not .git: {paths}
errors.too_many_cache: At most {max} lock files and {max} cache directories.
errors.file_path_empty: A support file has no path.
errors.file_path: Support file path "{path}" must be relative, without .., ./, // or a trailing /, without control characters, and at most {max} bytes.
errors.file_nul: Support file "{path}" has NUL bytes; only text files are taken.
errors.file_too_large: Support file "{path}" is larger than {max} bytes.
errors.files_too_large: The support files add up to more than {max} bytes.

status.none: No init script yet. Write the steps that bring the project up, or let an agent save what worked for it.

fields.script_hint: bash, runs from the workdir; params arrive as env vars
fields.ready_hint: exit 0 means the project is up
fields.setup_hint: bash, runs before the script; skipped when its output is already there
fields.tools_hint: installed with mise; empty uses the repo's mise.toml or .tool-versions
fields.cache_key_hint: when their content changes, setup runs again
fields.cache_paths_hint: what setup fills and a snapshot keeps
fields.files_hint: kept in Thulu, not in the repo; the script reads them from $OCTOPUS_INIT_FILES, and changing one runs setup again

history.title: Revisions of the init script
history.pick: Pick a revision to read it.
history.confirm_message: It is saved again as the newest revision. The current script stays in the history.

install.title: Install phase
install.hint: Dependencies are installed once per lock file version, then restored from a snapshot.

prewarm.title: Snapshot
prewarm.hint: built from the default branch every 10 minutes when the lock files change
prewarm.unavailable: Snapshots need the sandbox runtime, which this install does not run.
prewarm.not_eligible: Fill in setup and cache directories, and save, to keep a snapshot of the install.
prewarm.save_first: Save the script first: the prewarm uses the saved revision.

reason.image: The sandbox image is not on this machine. An operator has to build or load it before prewarms can run.
reason.sandbox: The sandbox is missing something snapshots need (a tool or the cache folder). An operator has to fix the sandbox setup.
reason.tools: Installing the declared tools failed. Check the names and versions under Tools.
reason.setup: The setup script failed on the default branch. The detail shows its output.
reason.no_paths: Setup ran, but none of the cache folders exist afterwards. Check the paths under Cache folders.
reason.timeout: The prewarm took too long and was stopped. A faster setup, or fewer cache folders, gets it under the limit.
reason.lost: The prewarm process was killed before it finished, usually for running out of memory.
reason.too_large: The default branch is too large to prewarm.
reason.unknown: The prewarm failed. The detail has the error the sandbox gave.

warnings.lockfile_missing: Not at the top of the default branch: {files}. Setup reruns when these files change, so a missing one never triggers it.

starter.run_comment: Start the app. Change this line to the command your project uses.
